name: Greek Moussaka
description: Moussaka, Greece's iconic layered eggplant and meat casserole, depends on real technique at every stage - the meat sauce is genuinely spiced with cinnamon, nutmeg, and oregano together, real egg yolks are whisked into the béchamel for structure and richness, and a spoonful of that béchamel is stirred back into the meat sauce first, which is what binds the layers together rather than leaving them as separate strata.
steps_detailed: Salt the eggplant slices and let sit 30 minutes, then pat dry and roast at 425F (220C) for 15-18 minutes.
Brown the lamb, add the tomatoes, cinnamon, nutmeg, and oregano, and simmer 15-18 minutes.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, cook 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the milk until thickened into a béchamel.
Off the heat, whisk the egg yolk into the béchamel for real richness and structure.
Stir a spoonful of the béchamel into the meat sauce - this real step is what binds the layers together.
Layer the roasted eggplant and meat sauce in a baking dish, top with the remaining béchamel, and bake at 375F (190C) for 30-35 minutes until deeply golden.

name: Greek Pastitsio
description: Pastitsio, often called Greek lasagna, is genuinely built the same way as moussaka - real meat sauce and béchamel layers - but with tube pasta in place of eggplant, real technique deglazing the meat with red wine and letting it fully reduce before the tomatoes go in.
steps_detailed: Cook the pasta per package directions.
Brown the beef, add the wine, and let it fully reduce and evaporate, 2-3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and cinnamon, and simmer 15-18 minutes.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, cook 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the milk until thickened into a béchamel, and whisk in the egg yolk off the heat.
Layer the pasta and meat sauce in a baking dish, top with the béchamel, and bake at 375F (190C) for 25-30 minutes until deeply golden.

name: Greek Tzatziki
description: Tzatziki, a cold yogurt and cucumber dip, real technique salting the cucumber first to draw out excess water so the dip stays thick rather than watery.
steps_detailed: Salt the grated cucumber and let sit 10 minutes, then squeeze out excess water.
Whisk the yogurt with the garlic and olive oil, then stir in the cucumber.
Chill at least 20 minutes before serving.

name: Greek Spanakopita
description: Spanakopita, a real spinach and feta pie in phyllo, real technique cooking the spinach until any released liquid fully evaporates so the pastry stays crisp.
steps_detailed: Cook the onion in the olive oil, 3-4 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook, stirring, until wilted and any released liquid has fully evaporated, 5-7 minutes.
Let cool slightly, then mix in the feta and beaten egg.
Layer the phyllo, brushing each sheet with oil, spread the filling, and roll or fold into a pie.
Bake at 375F (190C) for 25-28 minutes until deeply golden and crisp.

name: Greek Souvlaki
description: Souvlaki, skewered grilled meat, real technique marinating overnight so the lemon and oregano genuinely penetrate the meat.
steps_detailed: Marinate the chicken in the lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, and garlic for at least 2 hours, ideally overnight.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill over medium-high heat, turning, 10-12 minutes, until charred and cooked through.

name: Greek Horiatiki (Village Salad)
description: Horiatiki, Greece's real village salad, is genuinely built on ripe tomatoes and real feta served as a slab, not crumbled, real technique using a light hand with the dressing.
steps_detailed: Toss the tomatoes, cucumber, onion, and olives with the olive oil and oregano.
Top with a slab of feta rather than crumbling it in.

name: Greek Grilled Fish
description: Grilled fish rubbed with garlic and lemon, reflecting Greece's Mediterranean and Aegean coastal fishing tradition.
steps_detailed: Rub the fish with the garlic and lemon juice, and let sit 10 minutes.
Grill or broil, 4-5 minutes per side, until just cooked through.

steps_detailed: Toast the almonds in a dry pan over medium heat, stirring often, 4-5 minutes, until fragrant.

Add the carrot, potato, and tomatoes, and simmer 30-35 minutes until tender.
